CHBE 201.title: Integrated Technical Communication
CHBE 201.description: Written and oral communication in chemical and biological engineering. Business correspondence, laboratory and technical reports. .
CHBE 201.prerequisiteText: One of APSC_V 176, ENGL_V 110, ENGL_V 111, ENGL_V 112, ENGL_V 120, ENGL_V 121, WRDS_V 150

CHBE 220.title: Founding Principles in Chemical and Biological Engineering I
CHBE 220.description: Introduction to the Chemical and Biological Engineering profession, and the physical sciences that form the founding principles of design and the discipline. Recommended corequisite: CHBE_V 201. .
CHBE 220.prerequisiteText: One of CHEM_V 121 and CHEM_V 123 or CHEM_V 154, and MATH_V 101

CHBE 221.title: Founding Principles in Chemical and Biological Engineering II
CHBE 221.description: Introduction to Chemical and Biological Engineering profession with emphasis on the biological sciences that form the founding principles of the discipline. .

CHBE 230.title: Computational Methods
CHBE 230.description: Mathematical formulation of chemical and biological engineering problems; standard techniques of numerical analysis and their application to chemical, environmental and biotechnological systems; program development; use of commercial numerical analysis software.

CHBE 241.title: Material and Energy Balances
CHBE 241.description: Introduction to Chemical and Biological Engineering; units; stoichiometry; phase equilibria; material balances; energy balances. .
CHBE 241.prerequisiteText: One of CHEM_V 121 and CHEM_V 123 or CHEM_V 154 and one of MATH_V 152, MATH_V 221

CHBE 243.title: Introduction to Chemical and Biological Engineering Process and Technology
CHBE 243.description: Processes used in chemical and biological industries, which emphasize underlying physical, chemical, and biological principles. .

CHBE 244.title: Chemical and Biological Engineering Thermodynamics I
CHBE 244.description: Energy and the first law; second law of thermodynamics; entropy; availability (energy) analysis; thermodynamic properties of fluids, application to power generation, refrigeration, and liquefaction, as well as biological, environmental, and electrochemical systems. .

CHBE 251.title: Transport Phenomena I
CHBE 251.description: Fluid Mechanics. Momentum-transfer in fluids in laminar and turbulent flow; microscopic and macroscopic material; momentum and energy balances; rheology; dimensional analysis; flow in conduits; pumps; fluid metering. .

CHBE 262.title: Chemical Engineering and Applied Chemistry Laboratory
CHBE 262.description: Experiments chosen to illustrate and use material presented in 200-level CHBE and CHEM courses. .

CHBE 263.title: Introduction to Chemical and Biological Engineering Laboratory Practice
CHBE 263.description: Introduction to Chemical and Biological Engineering laboratory practice with topics in physical, inorganic and organic chemistry. .
CHBE 263.corequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 220, CHBE_V 241, CHEM_V 250, CHEM_V 260

CHBE 264.title: Chemical and Biological Engineering Laboratory
CHBE 264.description: Laboratory experiment in 2nd year Chemical and Biological Engineering. .

CHBE 344.title: Introduction to Unit Operations
CHBE 344.description: Foundational concepts and design equations for unit operations in chemical and biological systems. Examples related to clean energy systems are emphasized.

children.raw: Not for credit for CHBE students

CHBE 344.prerequisiteText: CHBE_V 241 and one of CHBE_V 251, CIVL_V 215. Not for credit for CHBE students

CHBE 345.title: Unit Operations
CHBE 345.description: Stage-wise mass transfer operations; extraction and absorption; single and stage-wise binary and multi-component distillation; principles and equipment design for continuous contact mass transfer operations including absorption, binary distillation and others such as extraction, drying, and humidification. .

CHBE 346.title: Chemical and Biological Engineering Thermodynamics II
CHBE 346.description: Volumetric and thermodynamic properties of fluids; equations of state; heat effects; ideal and non-ideal mixtures; fugacities and activity coefficients; vapor-liquid and liquid-liquid phase equilibrium; solubility of gases and solids in liquids; chemical reaction equilibrium; equilibrium partitioning of pollutants. Recommended prerequisite: MATH_V 256. .

CHBE 352.title: Transport Phenomena II
CHBE 352.description: Heat and mass transfer; conduction and molecular diffusion; convective transfer; analogies among heat, mass and momentum transfer; heat exchanger design; mass transfer coefficients; interphase mass transfer. .

children.raw: or third-year or higher standing in ENVE

CHBE 352.prerequisiteText: One of CHBE_V 251, CIVL_V 215 and MATH_V 256, or third-year or higher standing in ENVE

CHBE 355.title: Kinetics and Reactor Design
CHBE 355.description: Kinetics of homogeneous chemical and biological reactions, isothermal ideal reactor design, analysis of non-ideal reactors using residence time distribution and mixing models. .

CHBE 356.title: Process Dynamics and Control
CHBE 356.description: Introduction to modelling of chemical processes; transient response analysis; design of feedback control systems; stability analysis; frequency response analysis; process control applications; instrumentation; advanced control techniques; distributed control systems.

CHBE 362.title: Process Engineering Laboratory
CHBE 362.description: Experiments to illustrate and use material presented in 200 and 300-level CHBE courses. Field trips may be required. .
CHBE 362.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 201, CHBE_V 230, CHBE_V 241, CHBE_V 264

CHBE 364.title: Environmental Engineering Laboratory
CHBE 364.description: Laboratory experiments to illustrate key concepts and measurement techniques in environmental engineering as used by engineers. .

CHBE 365.title: Biological Engineering Laboratory
CHBE 365.description: Laboratory experiments to illustrate key concepts and measurement techniques in biotechnology as used by engineers. Field trips may be required. .

CHBE 366.title: Chemical Engineering Laboratory
CHBE 366.description: Experiments to illustrate and use material presented in 300-level Chemical Engineering program courses. Field trips may be required.

CHBE 370.title: Fundamentals of Sustainable Engineering
CHBE 370.description: Introduction to sustainable practice for Chemical and Biological Engineers. Pollution prevention, cleaner production, green chemistry and engineering, and sustainable design; environmental impact assessment including life-cycle assessment, total cost analysis and environmental systems analysis; applications in chemical and biological process industries. .

children.raw: or third-year or higher standing in ENVE

CHBE 370.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 241, CHBE_V 244, or third-year or higher standing in ENVE

CHBE 373.title: Water Technology and Engineering
CHBE 373.description: Fundamental principles along with regulatory and practical aspects of purifying water for drinking and treating wastewater for safe discharge or reuse. Engineering application of physical, chemical, and biological unit processes, designs, and operations for removal of impurities and pollutants; case studies from municipalities and process industries will be considered in detail.

children.raw: or third-year or higher standing in ENVE

CHBE 373.prerequisiteText: One of CHBE_V 251, CIVL_V 215, MECH_V 280, MTRL_V 263, or third-year or higher standing in ENVE

CHBE 376.title: Introduction to Process Design, Flowsheeting and Unit Operation Design
CHBE 376.description: Theory and practice of computer flowsheeting in chemical plant design; hands-on use of modern process simulators, prediction of thermodynamic properties of fluids; behaviour of single and multiphase systems. Design of unit operations. .

children.raw: for students enrolled in CHBE, or third-year or higher standing in B.A.Sc

CHBE 376.corequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 345, CHBE_V 355 for students enrolled in CHBE, or third-year or higher standing in B.A.Sc

CHBE 381.title: Biological Engineering and Biomanufacturing
CHBE 381.description: Biological process engineering in the fields of biotechnology and biomedical engineering; enzymatic and cellular kinetics; cell culture, bioreactor mass transport and process development; bioreactor design and operation.
CHBE 381.prerequisiteText: One of CHBE_V 221, BMEG_V 245 and one of MATH_V 101, MATH_V 103, MATH_V 105

CHBE 401.title: Mechanical Pulping and Papermaking
CHBE 401.description: Process and unit operations in mechanical pulping and papermaking, emphasizing principles and practice of refining, screening, cleaning, papermaking and properties of paper products, key economic and environmental issues. .

CHBE 402.title: Biomass Fractionation Technology
CHBE 402.description: Process and unit operations in the conversion of wood chips to pulp and green bio-products. Biorefinery concepts and emerging technologies for the production of biomaterials, biochemicals and bioenergy.

CHBE 410.title: Systems Biology and Metabolic Engineering
CHBE 410.description: Foundational concepts, experimentation methodologies, research horizons, and industrial applications of microbial cell engineering. Topics of note include genome-scale modeling, genome editing, biological circuits, protein engineering and the design-build-test-learn (DBTL) workflow.
CHBE 410.prerequisiteText: One of CHBE_V 381, CHBE_V 419 or BMEG_V 374

CHBE 411.title: Process Development: Bench to Full Scale
CHBE 411.description: Industrial approaches and techniques for the development and scale-up of novel process technologies including: technology feasibility evaluations; techno-economic analyses; formulation of development programs; scale-up of equipment and processes; technical de-risking; translation of development results into full scale design packages.
CHBE 411.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 241, CHBE_V 345 or equivalents

CHBE 412.title: Project Management in the Process Engineering Industries
CHBE 412.description: Organizational structure and roles. Stakeholder responsibilities. Project planning. Budget controls. Technical and process safety risk assessment. Performance evaluation in process engineering projects. Stakeholder engagement. Project definition and planning. Teamwork and leadership.

CHBE 419.title: Industrial Biotechnology Laboratory
CHBE 419.description: Modern bioreactor technology, upstream and downstream processing of biotechnology products. Restricted to students in the Joint Degree in Biotechnology.

CHBE 431.title: Molecular Cloning Laboratory
CHBE 431.description: Methods and techniques for molecular cloning and genome editing of microorganisms for application in biomanufacturing, biorefining, commodity biochemicals production, drug development, environmental bioremediation, and other sectors utilizing biotechnology.
CHBE 431.prerequisiteText: ?Either a) both CHEM_V 121 and CHEM_V 123, or b) CHEM_V 154; and one of CHBE_V 365 or BMEG_V 245

CHBE 451.title: Engineering Thermodynamics and Statistical Mechanics
CHBE 451.description: Classical thermodynamic relations from a molecular perspective. Pressure-volume-temperature relations; chemical equilibria by Gibbs' method; vapor-liquid equilibria; thermodynamic calculations based on macroscopic and statistical methods; nonequilibrium processes; molecular simulations. .

CHBE 452.title: Environmental Process Design Project
CHBE 452.description: 8-month project-based course, concepts from chemical, biological, and environmental science engineering with economics, life cycle analysis and health and safety considerations to solve problems related to the protection of the environment.
CHBE 452.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 241, CHBE_V 345, CHBE_V 356, CHBE_V 376

CHBE 453.title: Biological Process and Product Design
CHBE 453.description: 8-month project-based course, integrating chemical and biological engineering concepts with economics, life cycle analysis and health and safety considerations in the design of major biological processes.
CHBE 453.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 241, CHBE_V 345, CHBE_V 356, CHBE_V 376, CHBE_V 381

CHBE 454.title: Chemical Process and Product Design
CHBE 454.description: 8-month project-based course, integrating chemical engineering concepts with economics, life cycle analysis and health and safety considerations in the design of major chemical processes.
CHBE 454.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 241, CHBE_V 345, CHBE_V 356, CHBE_V 376

CHBE 455.title: Kinetics and Reactor Design
CHBE 455.description: Kinetics of homogeneous chemical and biological reactions, isothermal ideal reactor design, analysis of non-ideal reactors using residence time distribution and mixing models. .

CHBE 456.title: Heterogenous Catalysis and Advanced Reactor Design
CHBE 456.description: Definition of heterogeneous catalysis; properties of catalysts; kinetics of catalytic reactions; ideal heterogeneous reactors; non-isothermal reactor design; mass and heat transfer effects in heterogeneous reactors; examples of industrial reactors. .

CHBE 457.title: Process Synthesis
CHBE 457.description: Strategy for the conceptual design of industrial chemical and biological processes; rules of thumb for chemical engineers, simulation to assist process synthesis, reactor-separator network synthesis, introduction to product design and molecular structure design, efficiency and sustainability in the chemical industry.

CHBE 459.title: Chemical and Biological Engineering Economics
CHBE 459.description: Estimation of capital and operating costs; interest calculations; taxes; economic comparison of alternatives; economic optimization.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year or higher standing in BASc or BSc

CHBE 459.prerequisiteText: Third-year or higher standing in BASc or BSc

CHBE 464.title: Chemical and Biological Engineering Laboratory
CHBE 464.description: Experiments in unit operations relating to process, environmental and biological engineering. Experiments are designed to provide experience in instrumentation and control. Field trips may be required.
CHBE 464.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 362 and one of CHBE_V 365, CHBE_V 366

CHBE 465.title: Rehabilitation and Design of Aquatic Habitat
CHBE 465.description: Modelling the effects of the environment and nutrient availability on growth and waste production; designing closed and open environments for aquatic organisms; developing prescriptions for habitat rehabilitation. Restricted to students with third-year standing or higher.

CHBE 470.title: Transport in Biological Systems
CHBE 470.description: Mass transport and fluid flow, including physiological tissues and tissue constructs. Mass transport deficiencies that lead to the development of pathological tissue and drug delivery to these tissues. Biological engineering for the design of tissue constructs and artificial organs. .

CHBE 471.title: Chemical Process Engineering
CHBE 471.description: Selection and design of major equipment used in chemical process plants, including heat exchangers, separators, reactors. Recommended pre-requisite: CHBE_V 376.

CHBE 472.title: Technologies for Human and Environmental Health
CHBE 472.description: Fundamentals of cutting-edge bioanalysis technologies with an emphasis on applications in health and the environment. Concepts and calculations involving: separations, mass transfer, reaction kinetics, mixing, electrochemistry, and others. Analysis tools employed include: limits of detection, sensitivity, specificity, and other measures. Restricted to students with third-year standing or higher in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc.

CHBE 473.title: Environmental Engineering and Sustainability Leadership
CHBE 473.description: Topics may include: Life cycle assessment, circular economy, system dynamics modelling, design thinking, systems thinking, traditional ecological knowledge, adaptive and evolutionary leadership, and relationality.

CHBE 474.title: Process Control Engineering
CHBE 474.description: Frequency response analysis; advanced control techniques; multivariable control systems; mathematical tools for computer control systems; design of computer control systems; engineering design of industrial control applications; plant wide control concepts; distributed control systems concepts.

CHBE 476.title: Advanced Process Engineering and Simulation
CHBE 476.description: Mathematical modelling of chemical plants and processes; computer simulation; introduction to numerical optimization techniques.

children.raw: for students enrolled in CHBE, or fourth-year standing in B.A.Sc

CHBE 476.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 345, CHBE_V 376 for students enrolled in CHBE, or fourth-year standing in B.A.Sc

CHBE 477.title: Fuel Cell and Electrochemical Engineering
CHBE 477.description: Stoichiometry, thermodynamics and kinetics of electrode reactions; conductivity and mass transport in electrolytes; material, energy and voltage balances; design of electrosynthesis, electrorecovery of metals, and energy generation of batteries and fuel cells. .

children.raw: for students enrolled in CHBE, or third-year or higher standing in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc

CHBE 477.prerequisiteText: All of CHBE_V 220, CHBE_V 241, CHBE_V 346 for students enrolled in CHBE, or third-year or higher standing in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc

CHBE 478.title: Polymer Science and Processing
CHBE 478.description: Introduction to polymer and biopolymer chemistry, properties, processing and technological applications. Restricted to students with third-year standing or higher in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc.

CHBE 479.title: Occupational Health and Safety in Engineering
CHBE 479.description: Relationship between current engineering practice and worker health and safety. Engineering analysis of industrial health and safety problems. Restricted to students with third-year standing or higher in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc.

CHBE 480.title: Hazardous Waste Processing Technology
CHBE 480.description: Characterization, treatment and final disposal of hazardous waste with emphasis upon chemical engineering principles. Topics to include relevant legislation, in-plant minimization, treatment options and clean-up of contaminated sites. Case studies to be used for illustration.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year or higher standing in BASc or BSc

CHBE 480.prerequisiteText: Third-year or higher standing in BASc or BSc

CHBE 481.title: Biological Engineering and Bioprocess Design
CHBE 481.description: Introduction to key elements of Bioprocess Design. Bioprocess flowsheeting; production-scale fermenter design; product recovery and purification; bioseparations; chromatography; viral inactivation and removal; process validation.

CHBE 482.title: Energy Systems Modelling, Simulation and Optimization
CHBE 482.description: Synthesis, design and simulation of separation and reaction systems. Steady state and dynamic simulation. Application to energy systems optimization.

children.raw: fourth-year standing in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc

CHBE 482.prerequisiteText: CHBE_V 376 or fourth-year standing in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc

CHBE 483.title: Energy Engineering for Climate Change and Sustainability
CHBE 483.description: Supply and use of conventional and alternative fuels and energy. Design and operation of unit operations for processing of fossil fuels, biomass, and other energy sources. Environmental considerations of energy use. that address climate change and sustainability (water usage, environmental footprint, resource use, etc.). .

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing or higher in BASc or BSc

CHBE 483.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing or higher in BASc or BSc

CHBE 484.title: Green Engineering for Cyclic Economy
CHBE 484.description: Technologies for clean production of chemicals and materials, green chemistry and engineering, industrial ecology and sustainable development; advanced applications of environmental impact assessment including life-cycle assessment, total cost analysis and environmental systems analysis; reduce/recycling/reuse of wastes and by-products. Recommended prerequisite: CHBE_V 370. Restricted to students with third-year or higher standing in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc.

CHBE 485.title: Air Pollution Prevention and Air Quality Engineering
CHBE 485.description: Fate of air-born chemicals and the associated impacts of air pollutants on health, visibility, smog formation, ozone depletion and global warming; air quality and emission standards; atmospheric dispersion of air pollutants; prevention and control technologies for particulates, SOx, NOx, VOCs, and CO2.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year or higher standing in BASc. or BSc

CHBE 485.prerequisiteText: Third-year or higher standing in BASc. or BSc

CHBE 486.title: Waste Mitigation and Processing for Resource Recovery
CHBE 486.description: How chemical and biological waste impact the environment. Physico-chemical, thermal, and biological methods for minimizing, isolating and sustainably treating solid waste and wastewater, including conversion to bioproducts/ industrial products, energy and clean water. Restricted to students with third-year or higher standing in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc.

CHBE 487.title: Interfacial Phenomena
CHBE 487.description: Outline of the physics and chemistry of interfaces; discussion of the part played by surface effects in technical processes. Recommended prerequisite: One of CHBE_V 241, FNH_V 300. Restricted to students with third-year or higher standing in B.A.Sc. or B.Sc.

CHBE 488.title: Carbon Capture, Conversion and Sequestration Technologies
CHBE 488.description: Examination of carbon capture technologies, and CO2 conversion and sequestration options. Technical foundations on carbon cycle, thermodynamics, transport, absorption, adsorption, sequestration, mineralization and conversion. Analysis of cases in the context of technology, policy and regulatory framework. .
CHBE 488.prerequisiteText: One of CHBE_V 244, MTRL_V 252 and one of CHBE_V 251, CIVL_V 215, MTRL_V 263

CHBE 489.title: Pollution Control in the Pulp and Paper Industry
CHBE 489.description: Pollutants of concern in the pulp and paper industry; environmental impact of the industry; technologies used for the control of solid, liquid and gaseous wastes. .

CHBE 491.title: Thesis Proposal - Process Topic
CHBE 491.description: Literature searching, planning, equipment design, experimental design for an individual research project leading to a written proposal and oral presentation.

CHBE 492.title: Thesis - Process Topic
CHBE 492.description: Research project under the direction of a staff member. .

CHBE 493.title: Thesis Proposal - Environmental Topic
CHBE 493.description: Literature search, planning, equipment design for an individual research project leading to a written proposal and oral presentation. Topic to be chosen from a selection of environmental topics offered by the department.
CHBE 493.prerequisiteText: One of CHBE_V 364, CHBE_V 365 or CHBE_V 366

CHBE 495.title: Thesis Proposal - Biotechnology Topic
CHBE 495.description: Literature search, planning, equipment design for an individual research project leading to a written proposal and oral presentation. Topic to be chosen from a selection of biotechnology topics offered by the department.

CHBE 497.title: Topics in Chemical and Biological Engineering.

CHBE 498.title: Engineering Report
CHBE 498.description: This should be written on some subject of scientific interest or technical interest, based preferably on personal experience. Specifications are issued by the Department.

CHBE 502.title: Biomass Fractionation Chemistry
CHBE 502.description: Extraction of soluble compounds and macromolecules. Chemical and technical processes in production of pulp. Bleaching. Fiber production from woody and herbaceous biomass. Production of reactive intermediates.

CHBE 505.title: Introduction to Chemical Engineering for Non-Chemical Engineers

CHBE 506.title: Industrial Process Engineering
CHBE 506.description: Mass and energy balances. Stoichiometry. Flow diagrams. Key unit operations for selected process industries in Western Canada with special attention to emission controls and hazards. May require field trips. Not open to Chemical and Biological Engineering students.

CHBE 510.title: Optimization of Bioprocesses
CHBE 510.description: Experimental design, data analysis, model building, reactor dynamics and computer control for optimization.

CHBE 550.title: Advanced Reactor Design
CHBE 550.description: Kinetics of fluid-solid reactions of single particles, packed, moving, fluidized and transported bed reactors; rotary kilns; gasliquid reaction kinetics and reactor design; reactor design for gas-liquidsolid and non-catalytic processes.

CHBE 551.title: Engineering Thermodynamics and Statistical Mechanics
CHBE 551.description: Classical thermodynamic relations from a molecular perspective. Pressure-volume- temperature relations; chemical equilibria by Gibbs' method; vapor-liquid equilibria; thermodynamic calculations based on macroscopic and statistical methods; nonequilibrium processes; molecular simulations.

CHBE 552.title: Optimization Methods
CHBE 552.description: Basic concepts of optimization and structure of mathematical models. Gradient methods. Direct search methods. Gauss-Newton method for parameter optimization in models described by ordinary and partial differential equations. Constrained optimization. Statistical inferences. Design of experiments.

CHBE 553.title: Mathematical Operations in Chemical Engineering
CHBE 553.description: Dimensional analysis and model theory; treatment and interpretation of chemical engineering data; formulation and solution of differential and finite difference equations; graphical, numerical and statistical methods.

CHBE 554.title: Momentum, Heat and Mass Transfer
CHBE 554.description: Prediction of velocity, temperature, and concentration profiles for flowing fluids; unifying concepts and analogies in momentum, heat, and mass transport; streamline flow and turbulence, molecular and eddy conduction and diffusion, boundary layers, smooth and rough conduits and other boundaries.

CHBE 557.title: Fluid Dynamics
CHBE 557.description: Topics vary from year to year and include: governing equations for Newtonian fluids; numerical solutions to Navier-Stokes equations; incompressible boundary layers; stability analysis; turbulence; applied Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD); modelling multi-phase fluids by Eulerian and Lagrangian methods; commercial CFD software.

CHBE 559.title: Topics in Chemical Engineering
CHBE 559.description: A discussion of some aspects of modern Chemical Engineering. Subject matter varies each year.

CHBE 560.title: Biological Engineering and Bio-Manufacturing
CHBE 560.description: Biological process engineering in the fields of biotechnology and biomedical engineering; enzymatic and cellular kinetics; cell culture, bioreactor mass transport and process development; bioreactor design and operation. Critical analysis of recent biological engineering research articles. .

CHBE 561.title: Particle Technology
CHBE 561.description: Topics vary from year to year and include gas, liquid, and particle mechanics, fine and nano particles; colloidal phenomena; packed beds; filtration; sedimentation; two- and three-phase fluidized beds; spouted beds; hydraulic and pneumatic transport; multiphase flows.

CHBE 563.title: Applied Heterogeneous Catalysis
CHBE 563.description: Techniques for characterizing materials and catalysts. Modern understanding of catalyst fundamentals including scaling laws and descriptors. Impact of catalyst properties, mechanisms and kinetics on reactor engineering. Applications related to clean fuel and chemical production are emphasized. .

CHBE 564.title: Industrial Biotechnology Laboratory
CHBE 564.description: Modern bioreactor technology, upstream and downstream processing of biotechnology products. .

CHBE 565.title: Advanced Process Control
CHBE 565.description: Discrete-time chemical system modelling; model-based predictive control; predictive controller design; analysis of design parameters; controller stability; robustness and performance analysis; selected topics from current developments in the literature.

CHBE 566.title: Topics in Biological Engineering
CHBE 566.description: Critical analysis of biological engineering research articles and literature review in an area of focus. Topics chosen from: bioprocess, biosensor, biotechnology, and biomedical engineering.

CHBE 567.title: System Identification and Adaptive Control
CHBE 567.description: Input/Output modelling; frequency analysis; regression analysis; model parametrizations; recursive estimation methods; model validation; adaptive controller design; implementation issues; chemical process control applications; selected topics from current developments in the literature.

CHBE 570.title: Advanced Transport in Biological Systems
CHBE 570.description: Advanced studies in mass transport: material flow in biological systems from cellular to whole body level under normal and pathological conditions. Biological engineering approaches for designing tissue constructs and artificial organs.

CHBE 571.title: Non-Newtonian Fluid Behaviour
CHBE 571.description: Selections from the following topics: kinematics of deformation and flow, dynamics of continuous media, constitutive equations, physical chemical and molecular aspects of viscosity, engineering applications to pipe flow, mixing, heat transfer. Handling of suspensions and polymers.

CHBE 572.title: Technologies for Human and Environmental Health
CHBE 572.description: Fundamentals of cutting-edge bioanalysis technologies with an emphasis on applications in health and the environment. Concepts and calculations involving: separations, mass transfer, reaction kinetics, mixing, electrochemistry, and others. Analysis tools employed include: limits of detection, sensitivity, specificity, and other measures.

CHBE 573.title: Environmental Engineering and Sustainability Leadership
CHBE 573.description: Topics may include: Life cycle assessment, circular economy, system dynamics modelling, design thinking, systems thinking, traditional ecological knowledge, adaptive and evolutionary leadership, and relationality.

CHBE 574.title: Equilibrium Properties of Non-Ideal Mixtures
CHBE 574.description: Discussion of various methods of calculating vapor-liquid, liquid-liquid equilibrium and thermal properties, including molecular thermodynamics. Excess free-energy of mixing. Thermodynamic consistency tests. Emphasis on engineering applications and newer approaches.

CHBE 577.title: Electrochemical Science, Engineering and Technology
CHBE 577.description: Electrochemical interfaces; electrode reactions; thermodynamics; kinetics and transport processes in electrochemical systems; experimental techniques. Electrochemical reactors and processes; modelling, design and economics. Electrochemical technologies; electrosynthesis, batteries and fuel cells. Electro-metallurgy; electrowinning and refining of metals, corrosion, leaching and cementation.

CHBE 578.title: Polymer Science and Processing
CHBE 578.description: Polymer chemistry, polymer properties, polymer processing and technological applications. .

CHBE 580.title: Advanced Topics in Pulp and Paper Engineering
CHBE 580.description: Advanced material in selected topics in pulp and paper in science and engineering. Subject matter varies each year. .

CHBE 583.title: Energy Engineering for Climate Change and Sustainability
CHBE 583.description: Supply and use of conventional and alternative fuels and energy. Design and operation of unit operations for processing of fossil fuels, biomass, and other energy sources. Environmental considerations of energy use that address climate change and sustainability (water usage, environmental footprint, resource use, etc.).

CHBE 585.title: Air Pollution Prevention and Air Quality Engineering
CHBE 585.description: Fate of air-born chemicals and the associated impacts of air pollutants on health, visibility, smog formation, ozone depletion and global warming; air quality and emission standards; atmospheric dispersion of air pollutants; prevention and control technologies for particulates, SOx, NOx, VOCs, and CO2.

CHBE 587.title: Interfacial Phenomena
CHBE 587.description: Outline of the physics and chemistry of interfaces; discussion of the part played by surface effects in technical processes.

CHBE 588.title: Carbon Capture, Conversion and Sequestration Technologies

CHBE 590.title: Small Watershed Systems Design
CHBE 590.description: Hydrologic design of water management systems for the production of agricultural and other biological materials. Analysis and design of composite systems for watersheds.

CHBE 596.title: Engineering Report
CHBE 596.description: For M.Eng. students. Carry out a literature review, conduct a research or design project and prepare an engineering report under the supervision of a faculty member.

CHBE 597.title: Master's Thesis Proposal Development
CHBE 597.description: Techniques for preparation of a critical literature review and focussed research proposal for M.A.Sc. and M.Sc. candidates. Students perform oral and written critiques of published research in their area of study, define research questions and hypotheses, and develop a focussed research proposal.

CHBE 598.title: Master's Seminar
CHBE 598.description: Current topics in chemical and biological engineering research. Pass/Fail.

CHBE 697.title: Doctoral Thesis Proposal Development
CHBE 697.description: Techniques for preparation of a critical literature review and focussed research proposal for Ph.D. candidates. Students perform oral and written critiques of published research in their area of study, define research questions and hypotheses, and develop a focussed research proposal.

CHBE 698.title: Doctoral Seminar
CHBE 698.description: Current topics in chemical and biological engineering research. Pass/fail.
